_readme: Every value a future change would plausibly touch lives here (§8). Nothing in src/ hardcodes a category, a weight, a path, a count or a language. Edit this file, not the code. `npm run resolve:categories` re-resolves the OpenAlex field IDs against the live API and rewrites them in place.

output._siteName: TODO — the Czech-facing name is an open decision (§12). While it is null the pages render the working name below, and the run log says so on every run so it cannot be forgotten.

shortlist._readme: Semantic Scholar is one request per second (§4.2), so only the shortlist is enriched — never the full candidate set.

ranking._readme: Weights sum to 1. The ORDER of importance is fixed by §6 and must not be reordered; the magnitudes are tunable.
ranking._maxPerSubfield: §6 states the diversity cap as a rule, not a preference, so it is HARD: a day that cannot fill papersPerDay under the cap publishes fewer and says why (§3, §9). Raising it to reach the target is opt-in below.
ranking._relaxedMaxPerSubfield: Only consulted when relaxDiversityToReachTarget is true. The cap never goes above this value; five papers from one subfield would defeat §5's breadth. A relaxed run sets the diversityRelaxed flag so the degradation reaches the page footer.
ranking._minAbstractChars: §6 excludes papers whose abstract cannot support a §7.3 explanation. Applied only when there is no Semantic Scholar TLDR to fall back on.

style._readme: §2's plain-language and no-hype rules, enforced by a deterministic checker (DESIGN-NOTES A). Knobs only — the hype lexicon and the jargon term list are corpora and live in src/checks/lexicons.cs.ts, where each entry can carry its false-positive guard and its justification. Every threshold below cites the A.x subsection that justifies it.

hype._readme: A.1.1 #36 and A.1.2 #37 — how far past a hit the false-positive guard looks (průlomová bolest, zlomový okamžik).

english._readme: A.2.3. A sentence is untranslated English only if ALL five conditions hold. Condition 4 (zero Czech diacritics) is the strong one.

readability._readme: A.3.2 table R1–R9, computed over blocks 2–5 concatenated. R5's thresholds are provisional (Open Question OQ-2): Czech derivation makes 4-syllable words ordinary, so the intuitive 10 % is unmeetable.

jargon._readme: A.4.2. A parenthesis holding only the English original is a §2 term marker, not a gloss — hence parenGlossMinCzechWords.

numbers._readme: A.5.3. An anchor counts only when it is followed by real words, and it may sit in the next sentence.

warnBudget._readme: A.6 — at most 1 warn per 100 words of blocks 2–5, and at most 4 per paper. Exceeding either sets status=warn, which never blocks publication.

verification._readme: §7.4 / §11 step 8. A fabricated example is the worst failure this project can produce, so the verifier runs as a separate call that sees only the source text and the candidate example, and the code independently checks that every quote it cites really occurs in the source.

openalex._apiKey: Read from OPENALEX_API_KEY in .env.local — never stored here.
openalex._requireApiKey: Set true once the key exists, so an unattended run fails loudly instead of silently dropping to the 100/day unkeyed allowance.

semanticScholar._throttleMs: §4.2 — 1 request/second. 1100 ms, sequential, never parallel; kept even when a key is present.

http._readme: §9 — retry twice with backoff, then continue without that source.
